title: GoLingua request-local reference and condition context
description: Explicit, request-local referents, mention links, inert evidence, and semantic conditions. This document is not a persistent memory or fact store.
$comment: Runtime enforces a 1048576-byte JSON limit, nesting at most 256, IDs at most 256 UTF-8 bytes, 512 referents, 512 mentions, 1024 evidence rows, 128 conditions, 4096 aggregate condition-expression nodes, and 262144 checker work units. Nominal referent sorts must exist in the actual checked declaration document. SourceRef.Validate enforces exactly one usable path or URI. Evidence provenance integrity does not prove world truth. Resolution status is derived only from explicit evidence rows.

speaker_referent_id.$comment: Optional request-local anchor; it does not identify a person outside this context.

addressee_referent_id.$comment: Optional request-local anchor; it does not identify a person outside this context.

oneOf.$comment: The nominal sort must be declared in the actual checked document.

concept_id.$comment: Optional classification metadata only; equal concept IDs never merge referents.

referent_id.$comment: A target claim requires corroborating resolution_evidence.

source.$comment: Attribution integrity only, not a truth certificate.

code.$comment: Opaque label; it is not interpreted as a predicate or rule.

expression.$comment: If present, runtime checks this expression has type Prop. It is not evaluated.

detail.$comment: Human-readable detail only; runtime bound is UTF-8 bytes.
